DataPipelines.description: The limits of data pipelines, used by the 'OrchardCore.DataPipelines' feature. Can be set for all tenants or per tenant. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/DataPipelines/.

MaxRowsInMemory.description: The number of rows a step that must see every row before it writes any, such as a sort or the right input of a join, may hold in memory. A run fails rather than exhausting the memory of the server.

RunRetentionDays.description: The number of days the runs of a pipeline are kept; older runs are deleted. 0 keeps them.

PreviewRowLimit.description: The number of rows each source reads when a step is previewed in the designer.
